title: Hamdi Bozbag Mod
description: A mod that adds Hamdi Bozbag Elements to your game!
body:
This mod brings Hamdi Bozbag Anatolian High School (HBAL) content to the game. Such as teachers as mobs and school building as a structure. Also new ores and a new dimension all related to HBAL!
![Hamdi Bozbag Structure](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b921a7021b923bec88a0cae86a7f8cd3a853dbe_0.webp)
